description:
Search publication metadata.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table literature — one record = one (publication, entity) co-mention from Europe PMC text mining.
Key: pmid, keywordId.
Arguments: pmid accepts pmid (resolved; unknown -> error); keyword_id accepts literature word or ensembl gene or ot disease or chembl molecule (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Europe PMC text-mined entity mentions integrated by OT 25.09; absence means not text-mined, not that the paper is irrelevant.
served from the literature table by the data layer: keyword_id uses its sidecar index and pmid its row-group statistics; a year-only search is refused as too large

keyword_id.description: Accepts literature_word, ensembl_gene, ot_disease, chembl_molecule; resolved to one literature_word (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

pmid.description: Accepts pmid; resolved to one pmid (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
